scenes.narration: Ava bought a notebook. But the first page had to be perfect.
scenes.caption: The first page had to be perfect.

scenes.narration: So she waited for a better idea. Then a better pen. The page stayed empty.
scenes.caption: A better idea. A better pen.

scenes.narration: One evening, she wrote a terrible sentence. And left it there.
scenes.caption: One terrible sentence.

scenes.narration: The next day, she wrote another. Then another.
scenes.caption: Then another.

scenes.narration: A month later, the notebook was full of crossed-out words. And actual stories.
scenes.caption: Crossed-out words. Actual stories.

scenes.narration: That first page was never perfect. It just needed to exist.
scenes.caption: It just needed to exist.
